title: Add a test for OutboxSyncWriteFacade's onEnqueueDrain chain — write_tee_status_update_test.dart only unit-tests recordDrainAttempt() in isolation
why: The file's own docstring names the bug precisely: OutboxSyncWriteFacade.onEnqueueDrain called drain() without the follow-up recordDrainAttempt(), so the sync badge stayed falsely 'Synced'. The fix — chaining recordDrainAttempt() after drain() — is correctly wired today at sync_providers.dart:105-108 (verified by reading it). But both tests in this file build a bare SyncOrchestratorImpl and call `orchestrator.recordDrainAttempt()` directly; neither constructs an OutboxSyncWriteFacade or exercises the onEnqueueDrain closure at all. recordDrainAttempt() is a one-line wrapper (`=> _recomputeOutboxStatus()`), so this mostly re-tests status computation, not the chaining bug. There is no test file for sync_providers.dart or outbox_sync_write_facade.dart anywhere in test/ (checked via `find`), so nothing would fail if a future provider refactor drops the recordDrainAttempt() call again — the exact original bug could silently reappear with this whole suite green.
recommendation: Add a test (e.g. test/features/sync/presentation/providers/sync_providers_test.dart or test/features/sync/data/outbox_sync_write_facade_test.dart, mirroring AG-5) that builds the real OutboxSyncWriteFacade/onEnqueueDrain closure with a failing pipeline and asserts the sync-status badge updates without a manual recordDrainAttempt() call from the test body.
acceptance_criteria: A test exists at a path mirroring lib/features/sync/presentation/providers/sync_providers.dart or lib/features/sync/data/outbox_sync_write_facade.dart.
That test drives OutboxSyncWriteFacade's write-tee (enqueue → onEnqueueDrain) end to end and asserts recordDrainAttempt() fires without the test calling it directly.
